headline: Nevish Line Flares Into Severe Combat Across Disputed Northern Fronts
war_summary: Since the previous report, Nevish Line has erupted into the war's most volatile sector, logging 13 base transitions in the past two hours alone as fighting centers around Grief Mother, Blackcoat Way, and Princefal alongside sharply accelerating casualties. Callahan's Passage maintains an equally ferocious tempo, recording six additional base flips and over 2,000 combined casualties over the last two hours amidst see-saw clashes at Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage. To the east, Weathered Expanse remains heavily engaged around Shattered Advance and Crow's Nest, marked by accelerating casualty totals and three fresh sector exchanges. Palantine Berm registered five rapid base changes between Leiri Hermanni and The Pippeli Stones despite a marked drop in casualty rates. Meanwhile, Stonecradle witnessed fresh upheaval with Trammel Pool falling into contested neutral hands, while Stlican Shelf cooled to a single base transaction. Frontline attrition remains steady across Mooring County, whereas the southern backlines continue in undisturbed quiet.
